environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet rule that inspects the Body of POST requests to /api/v1/upload. The rule uses a byte-match condition on the raw multipart body scanning for sequences containing '../' (hex 2e2e2f) and '..\' (hex 2e2e5c) patterns within the first 8KB of the body payload. Additionally, the WebACL has a size constraint rule limiting request body to 10MB. The WAF is configured with OverrideAction: none and the custom rule has Action: BLOCK with a 403 response. The WAF logs to CloudWatch Logs with full request body sampling enabled for blocked requests. Note: the WAF body inspection uses the 'BODY' field type with OversizeHandling set to 'MATCH' meaning oversized bodies are also blocked.
